name: BubblaV – AI Chatbot & Live Chat for Customer Support
author: Ton Nguyen

sections.description:
BubblaV – AI Chatbot & Live Chat for Customer Support

Transform your customer support with an AI chatbot and live chat. BubblaV is an AI support assistant that:

  • Provides Instant Responses – Answer customer questions 24/7, reducing wait times and improving satisfaction
  • Learns Your Content – Automatically crawls your website to provide accurate, context-aware answers
  • Seamless Human Handoff – Escalate complex issues to live support agents when needed
  • One-Click Setup – No coding required. Connect and deploy in under 5 minutes
  • WooCommerce Ready – Detects WooCommerce to provide e-commerce-aware support

Key Features

  • Automatic Website Learning – Reads your pages, posts, and products to answer questions accurately
  • Beautiful Widget Design – Professional, customizable chat widget that matches your brand
  • Real-Time Analytics – Track conversations, user satisfaction, and common questions
  • Multi-Language Support – Serve customers in their preferred language
  • Mobile Responsive – Works perfectly on all devices

Perfect For

  • E-commerce stores (WooCommerce integration)
  • SaaS companies
  • Service businesses
  • Educational websites
  • Any website that needs customer support

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Click “Connect to BubblaV” to create your free account
  3. The AI automatically learns from your website content
  4. Start providing instant AI-powered support to your visitors

Free Plan Features

  • 1 website, up to 50 pages
  • 100 AI messages per month
  • Answers from your own website content
  • Human handoff when a visitor asks for it

Pro Plan Features

  • 5 websites, up to 5,000 pages per website
  • 5,000 AI messages per month
  • Live chat and support tickets
  • Weekly content sync
  • Custom branding
  • 3 team members
  • Email support

Visit BubblaV.com for premium plans.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “BubblaV” or “AI chatbot”
  4. Click Install Now
  5. Click Activate
  6. Follow the setup wizard to connect your site

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Log in to your WordPress dashboard
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  4. Click Upload Plugin
  5. Select the ZIP file and click Install Now
  6. Click Activate
  7. Go to Settings > BubblaV Chat to connect

Setup

  1. After activation, go to Settings > BubblaV Chat
  2. Click the “Connect to BubblaV” button
  3. Sign in or create your free BubblaV account
  4. The plugin will automatically configure itself
  5. Your chat widget is now live!
sections.faq:
Is the plugin really free?

Yes! The plugin is free with a generous free plan (100 messages/month). Premium plans are available for higher volume and advanced features.

Do I need to know how to code?

No coding required. The plugin handles everything automatically. Just connect your account and you’re done.

Will this slow down my website?

No. The widget loads asynchronously from our fast CDN, so it won’t impact your page load times.

Can I customize the widget appearance?

Yes! You can customize colors, position, and behavior from your BubblaV dashboard.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes! The plugin automatically detects WooCommerce and enables e-commerce features like product-aware responses.

What if the AI can’t answer a question?

You can enable human handoff, where visitors are connected to your live support team when the AI needs help.

Is my data secure?

Yes. We use industry-standard encryption. Our Privacy Policy lists the AI providers that process your content and conversations, and how long we keep your data.

Can I use this on multiple websites?

Yes! Each website connects to your BubblaV account. Premium plans support multiple websites.

1.0.9

  • Readme: new plugin name, shorter summary, plan features that match the pricing page, no model-provider claim

1.0.8

  • WooCommerce: product details and product search now include the product SKU
  • WooCommerce: searching by SKU returns the exact product (including variation SKUs)

1.0.7

  • Declared WooCommerce HPOS (custom order tables) compatibility
  • Fixed OAuth connection completion from the admin settings screen
  • Security hardening: admin notices escaped, API token encrypted at rest, token removed on uninstall
  • i18n and escaping corrections for the WordPress.org review
  • Removed unused code

1.0.6

  • Added comprehensive WooCommerce tools for order management, product details, returns, and discount validation

1.0.5

  • Release tooling and deployment fixes

1.0.4

  • Added authenticated REST API endpoints for content search, pages, products, and orders
  • Blocked unpublished content from leaking through REST lookups

1.0.3

  • Widget script tag now outputs directly for faster frontend injection
  • OAuth callback flow moved to admin-post.php

1.0.1

  • Externalized admin CSS and JS assets
  • Addressed WordPress plugin review feedback

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • One-click OAuth connection
  • Automatic widget injection
  • WooCommerce detection
  • Admin settings page
  • Security hardening (nonce verification, sanitization, escaping)
